      private int ReadNames(global::LtMsgPack.Reading.ReadContext c, ref global::Shop.Money o, global::LtMsgPack.Reading.PropReader[] props, ref int count, global::LtMsgPack.Generated.GeneratedReadPlan p)
      {

        read0:

          return next;

        read1:
